crossRefs.note: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia…
But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone…
but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you…

translations.web: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
translations.bsb: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
translations.kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
translations.asv: They therefore that were scattered abroad, went about preaching the word.
